title: VFS opens nominations for Associate Technical Fellow Award
summary: The ATF recognizes VFS members who have established a distinguished technical career through professional achievement, technical contributions, publications, and sustained service to the vertical flight community.
body_markdown:
The Vertical Flight Society has opened nominations for the inaugural[Associate Technical Fellow (ATF) Award](https://us.list-manage.com/uka17HbVbUj?e=5d122a7416&c2id=b54d7cb51571739ae1ed3a9762fb5405&m=sGB8fXNy5m-etQ_dbWE3tiZjK0r2_15vnjLginRTFhYIJzbcivBPiY4j3I6D) .


The ATF recognizes VFS members who have established a distinguished technical career through professional achievement, technical contributions, publications, and sustained service to the vertical flight community.


Self-nominations are welcome, as are nominations submitted on behalf of deserving colleagues. Nominations are open through September 31, 2026.


[Associate Technical Fellows](https://us.list-manage.com/IKn_YMHcf5r?e=5d122a7416&c2id=b54d7cb51571739ae1ed3a9762fb5405&m=1dFnooeySJH5vPojHUwnJAnG0EGFCkxjW4nVmf4ZAwDkpKnMvWSgVIOqExBQ) will receive a certificate and be recognized on the VFS awards page alongside other VFS awardees. There are no additional dues associated with the award beyond standard VFS membership.


**Eligibility Highlights**


- At least five consecutive years of VFS membership beyond student membership
- Sustained VFS service and leadership, including committees, chapters, the Board, or Technical Council
- Technical publications and professional recognition in vertical flight
- Demonstrated career impact in engineering, research, development, test, operations, or related vertical flight roles


*Note: VFS Honorary Fellows and Technical Fellows are not eligible.*


The scoresheet helps nominees document their experience, contributions, publications, membership history, and service. While numerical totals provide a consistent framework for review, final selection is based on the overall quality, significance, and sustained impact of each nominee’s contributions.


*This press release was prepared and distributed by the Vertical Flight Society.*
